evidence_sources.scope: repository landing page, README and file-tree metadata
dataset construction, labels, splitting and limitations

evidence_items.finding: The public pages showed main and a 30-commit history, but the bounded renderer did not expose a complete immutable commit hash or signed release identifier.

Official documentation enumerates inert sample and metadata paths including samples/taxonomy_sample_320.jsonl, its CSV form, samples/curated_eval_512.jsonl, metadata/dataset_stats.json, metadata/checksums.json and metadata/release_manifest.json. The canonical 64,000-row data/records.jsonl is generated locally and is not committed, so an exact acquirable inert-file allowlist is not yet established.

DATA_LICENSE.md states PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0 for permitted non-commercial research, education, testing and evaluation and requires separate written authorization for commercial use, paid services, commercial redistribution, production deployment, model-as-a-service, hosted services or commercial products.

An official dataset card documents intended and out-of-scope uses, deterministic synthetic construction, labels, campaign/variant-family splitting, limitations and required independent real-world validation.

README documents metadata/checksums.json and metadata/release_manifest.json and states the release manifest contains SHA-256 inventory for distributed files. Their actual contents and coverage were not opened by this metadata-only release.

The dataset card says version 1.2.0 is entirely synthetic, distinguishes review_status, confines campaign and variant families to one split and requires future real samples to remain in separate licence/provenance partitions. The exact translated/reviewed partition manifest was not inspected.

Individual inert sample and metadata paths are publicly enumerated, allowing a later data-file-only design in principle, but the canonical corpus is generated locally and no hash-pinned no-code acquisition allowlist has yet been frozen.

evidence_sources.scope: gated dataset card, schema, ethics and license
peer-reviewed paper landing page and abstract

evidence_items.finding: The public page identifies CC BY-NC 4.0 and requires users to share Hugging Face information and accept conditions before file access, but the unauthenticated public view does not expose the complete gated conditions.

The ACL paper establishes 1,836 victim-reported scam messages and 1,834 legitimate examples and a human-AI annotation pipeline. The inspected public metadata does not establish detailed upstream source identities or record-level linkage.

The public schema documents message, loss, location, report date, business name, annotation and category fields, but the bounded evidence does not establish a stable incident, source, report, campaign or family identifier for leakage-safe grouping.

The card says scam records derive from public scam reports and that location may be anonymized or missing. A complete PII-removal, consent/public-report basis and privacy-review procedure was not established by the inspected metadata.

The peer-reviewed abstract documents a human-AI collaborative pipeline using expert-labeled examples to calibrate and validate LLM-assisted annotation, but the bounded evidence does not fully establish independent adjudication or label-evidence independence for every record.

Each scam CSV row documents both description and rewrite_description, providing direct original-to-rewrite linkage. No stable group identifier or explicit all-variants-in-one-split rule was established.

The gated tree exposes Scam and Non-scam directories plus README and LICENSE sizes, and the card lists category CSV names and a 10.2 MB total. Per-file sizes and cryptographic checksums were not established.

evidence_sources.publisher: Vietnamese SMS Dataset research team / Hugging Face
evidence_sources.scope: official file-tree metadata, repository commit prefix and file sizes

evidence_items.finding: The official card defines only binary labels 0=legitimate and 1=spam/scam. The bounded public metadata does not establish a publisher-defined investment-scam subtype, category field or immutable investment subset.

The card names multiple team members who co-developed annotation guidelines and performed annotation and describes manual PII QA and Jaccard-based duplicate filtering. It does not publish the detailed annotation guide, independent adjudication outcomes or inter-annotator agreement in the inspected metadata.

The card states messages came from multiple legitimate sources with contributor consent and full_dataset.csv carries message_id and date, but no privacy-safe per-record contributor/source provenance field is documented.
A Jaccard similarity threshold of at least 0.85 is documented for near-duplicate removal, but no campaign, sender, template, contributor or duplicate-family grouping key is established.

The tree identifies test.csv as a 119 kB file and the card fixes its role and size at 597 rows; the repository tree shows verified commit prefix a90e2bd. A full immutable file hash for sealing was not established.

The official tree identifies full_dataset.csv (778 kB), train.csv (602 kB) and test.csv (119 kB), while the card fixes their row counts at 2,991, 2,394 and 597. Cryptographic checksums were not established.
The official card documents CC BY 4.0, IRB Exemption IRB-2026-NLP-0428, voluntary informed consent and replacement of PII with standardized placeholder tokens followed by manual residual-PII checks.
